slides.title: LLM Reliability
slides.subtitle:
Is the cheaper model safe?
Is this answer still true?
slides.body:
Two production checks for LLM apps, one console:
Bifrost Replay Lab and the Stale-Answer Detector.

slides.title: Teams guess on cost and on freshness today
slides.subtitle: The two failure modes we target, and what each one costs.

cards.heading: Overpaying for models
cards.body:
Teams stay on a flagship model
because nobody can prove a cheaper
one is safe on their own traffic.
cards.emphasis: Cost: the gap between tiers, every month.

cards.heading: Stale answers
cards.body:
Models state prices, versions and
CEOs from training data, with full
confidence, long after they change.
cards.emphasis: Cost: user trust, one wrong fact at a time.

slides.callout: Both need evidence, not opinion: your own traffic, and the live web.

slides.title: Bifrost Replay Lab
slides.subtitle: A switch verdict from your own production traffic.

slides.title: Replay Lab turns recorded traffic into a verdict
slides.subtitle: Native Bifrost plugin (LLMPlugin + HTTPTransportPlugin), or a sidecar proxy.

steps.heading: Capture
steps.body:
Off the hot path;
a full buffer drops
the capture, never
slows the request.

steps.heading: Protect
steps.body:
Emails, phones, cards
and tokens redacted
before disk.

steps.heading: Replay
steps.body:
Same params, temp 0,
against cheaper
candidates.

steps.heading: Decide
steps.body:
JSON contract,
similarity, p50/p95,
errors, cost.

banner.heading: Hard budget cap
banner.body: Projected cost checked before every call  •  stops with partial results  •  dry-run estimate first

slides.title: gpt-4o-mini kept 94.7 quality at 94.1% lower cost
slides.subtitle: Demo run: 200 gpt-4o requests captured, 50 replayed per candidate (mock provider).
slides.source: Replay Lab README, run_experiment output. Deterministic mock provider; live Gemini run: 5/5 replays, 0 errors.

side.heading: Verdicts
side.body:
gpt-4o-mini: **safe to switch**

claude-3-haiku: switch with caution

llama-3.1-8b: do not switch (50% valid JSON)

slides.callout: The cheapest model is not the answer; the verdict says which one is.

slides.subtitle: Every claim, checked against the live web with Tavily.

slides.title: Only claims that can go stale cost a search
slides.subtitle: Five stages, streamed live to the console over SSE.
